description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Twin Element Mode II (Earth, Holy) v2], [Awoken Knight], [Damage Cap +10000], [Reequip Mode], [Reequip Mode Critical Chance] and [Shatter Accessory] to the user

description.name: Awoken Knight
description.text: Knight abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Earth, Holy) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Earth/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Reequip Mode
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Knight abilities used (0~4), cast speed x2.00, grants [Reequip Mode Critical Chance] after using a Knight ability

description.name: Reequip Mode Critical Chance
description.text: Critical chance =0/25/50/75/100% scaling with [Reequip Mode], removed if the character hasn't [Reequip Mode]

description.name: Shatter Accessory
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth]/[Attach Holy] after using three Earth or Holy abilities if the triggering ability deals Earth/Holy damage

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%
